comment: The toolchains of session-store that no other file declares. npm is declared in the devEngines.packageManager of package.json and Rust in rust-toolchain.toml. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs and mise.lock locks them. bay is the release that make install-bay installs with the sha256 of each platform.

bay.comment: The release of bay that starts the Redis servers of the tests (SE-10.4), with the sha256 of its archive of each platform. A run fails at its start when the bay that it starts is of another version, because a server that another build starts is not the result that another machine repeats; make install-bay installs this release into var/tools/bay. The pin is raised to a later release that the tests need; it is removed with the servers of the tests.
